levels.surface: ابن أخي عبد الله بن سلام
ابن محمد بن عبد الله بن سلام

notes: Abdullah ibn Salam speaks inside the nephew's story («فقال … فخرج عبد الله إلى الناس فقال»): last link (owner ruling 5).
«ابن أخي» is a kinship phrase kept inside the surface, as written.
«وقد رواه شعيب بن صفوان …» gives another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group (rule 4); «جده» + name is one link (rule 7).
Tirmidhi's grading remark and the compiler's name note are left out.
